seed_rules.decision_logic: If a construction product falls within an applicable harmonised route, require the corresponding declared-performance / CE evidence before marking it compliant for the intended use.
Electrical product suitability is not enough; installation design and execution must be checked against applicable REBT requirements and project conditions.
Thermal equipment selection must be checked as part of a compliant thermal system, including energy-efficiency and control requirements.
A proposed self-consumption system must be routed through the applicable Andalusian legalization/registration path based on system configuration and installed capacity.
